notes: 49 vitest tests green in packages/sim (ecs 6, move 9, raycast 7, locomotion 14, schedule 7, replay 6): 1000-tick random-input non-penetration, resting stability, step 0.5/1.0/1.5, DDA invariants, reach 5.0 boundary and zero-component rays, FACE/normal agreement, fall-damage table, fixed 20Hz accumulator with the 250 ms clamp and SYSTEM_ORDER, replay determinism. | Deviation 1: voxels are unit cubes, so the 0.5/1.0/1.5 step acceptance is encoded as (a) auto-step succeeds iff stepHeight >= ledge height, so a 1-block ledge is stepped only with stepHeight 1.2 and is blocked with the contract 0.6, (b) a 1.0 ledge is climbable by jumping, (c) 1.5 and taller is not, verified with a 2-block wall. | Deviation 2: vertical integration moves with the velocity the tick starts with and applies gravity afterwards (Minecraft order), giving a discrete jump apex of 1.32 blocks against the analytic jumpVelocity^2/(2*gravity)=1.1025. Applying gravity before the move gives only 0.9 blocks, which would make a 1.0 ledge unclimbable by either stepping or jumping and would break the acceptance criterion. | Deviation 3: PHYSICS.maxSubSteps (8) is deliberately not a hard cap in moveEntity, because at terminal velocity a 50 ms step is 3.92 blocks while 8 * 0.45 = 3.6 would allow tunnelling; the sub-step count derives from maxSubStepBlocks only. | Deviation 4: simSin/simCos in src/shared/math.ts replace Math.sin/Math.cos because core-types/rng.ts forbids them in simulation. | Deviation 5: AIR_CONTROL = 0.2 is local tuning; the contract defines no mid-air control constant. | Deviation 6: moveEntity treats velocity as the per-step displacement in blocks, since the contract signature carries no dt; callers scale by dt. | ECS semantics: create() is immediate, add/remove/destroy are buffered while a query snapshot is live and applied by flush(), get/has/alive report the pre-flush state, freed ids are reused deterministically and query() returns ascending ids. | No contract changes needed; packages/core-types, docs/orchestration, CI and dependency declarations are untouched. | L2 status at this report: sim-b (light + fluid) and sim-c (mob, AI, pathfind, combat) sessions are running, both remote branches are still at ae0f134 with no commits; src/light, src/fluid, src/mob, src/pathfind and src/combat are placeholder index files owned by them. Next: merge --no-ff feat/mc-20260916/sim-b and sim-c into sim-a, re-run the four gates, then flip status to done.
